doc: The @cue vocabulary of .dlg files (docs/kb/tech/dialogue_format.md). tools/dlgc.py rejects unknown cues, unknown key= arguments, and values outside these types and option sets. Arg types: id (letters, digits, _), number, int, bool, string, emotion (game/data/dialogue/emotions.json), enum (values, or a named set). Positional args are listed in order; optional ones come last. one_of: exactly one of these names must be given. requires: key -> the name it needs.

music.silence: Not a track: fade the music bed out to nothing (fade= sets the time).

camera.doc: Cut or blend to an authored shot. grade= also blends the color grade to that color-script frame.

anim.doc: Play a body animation, optionally aimed at a target (actor, mark, or prop).

mark.doc: Move an actor to a scene mark.

face.doc: Override the facial expression over sec seconds (otherwise lines' [emotion] drives it).

music.doc: Change the music bed. 'silence' is reserved (see reserved.music).

sfx.doc: Play a one-shot sound. vol is a linear gain (1.0 = as authored); at= places it on an actor or mark.

vfx.doc: Trigger a VFX. Glimmer light rules: glimmer_lift rises (motion=spiral_up), glimmer_held sinks (drift=down_seaward), glimmer_bound is still.

wait.doc: Pause the sequence for sec seconds, or until the music reaches marker (music=). max= is the sequencer's fallback timeout for a music wait.
